findings.summary: executeBatch redundantly re-runs verifyBuildPasses and verifyCodeChange via verifyComment on already-pushed code, severely degrading performance and risking nondeterministic failures.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract the remote/GitHub verification logic (verifyReplyPosted and verifyRemoteFixCommit) out of verifyComment and call only those post-push, or pass a flag to verifyComment to skip mechanical/semantic code checks if called from executeBatch.

findings.summary: ProcessPrReviewDeps lacks renderBatchTaskPrompt and extractBatchTaskResult, which will cause executeBatch to crash at runtime.
findings.suggested_fix: Add renderBatchTaskPrompt and extractBatchTaskResult to ProcessPrReviewDeps and provide them during instantiation in compose.ts.

findings.summary: PollTaskRunnerDeps is missing fixDiffInspector?: FixDiffInspectorPort, preventing executeBatch from performing structural diff verification atomically before pushing the batch.
findings.suggested_fix: Add fixDiffInspector?: FixDiffInspectorPort to PollTaskRunnerDeps and invoke it alongside verifyCodeChange in executeBatch prior to pushing.
